messages:
maria - AE: FYI — kickoff w/ Acme Health at 11. They want a 4-week POC: document search + answer generation + a simple tool-call for a facts API. Need to align success criteria and model fit before tonight's scoping doc.

kevin - SE: Quick list of what we should validate: latency SLOs, rerank quality, embedding recall on their doc set, context length for multi-doc synth, tool-calling reliability. Any hard constraints from them?

jordan - Customer Success: They're strict on privacy — must be able to run in VPC or Dedicated. Also SOC2 + syslog/audit retention asked in their questionnaire. Budget-wise they sign after we hit cost targets (aiming <= $1.5k/month for baseline POC infra).

maria - AE: Good notes. For success criteria proposal I'm thinking: 1) Retrieval+rerank: average NDCG@5 >= 0.82 on our eval set; 2) Generation: factual accuracy >= 90% on 200 sampled QA pairs; 3) Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for generate (single-turn) and < 150ms for rerank; 4) Security: deployable in their VPC with KMS + audit logs. Thoughts?

kevin - SE: Those are reasonable. I'd tighten the latency SLO if they expect interactive UI — 95p < 250ms is realistic on Dedicated with batching tuned, but depends on model size. If we use a 32k context model we might see higher latency unless we use quantized weights + batching.

sam - Solutions Eng: For model choices: recommend testing two tracks in POC: (A) dense-embed + reranker using an embedding model (embed-medium) + cross-encoder reranker (rerank-small) for top-10, (B) end-to-end LLM rerank with tool-calls for provenance. Track A costs less and is faster; Track B gives better conversational synthesis.

maria - AE: Client prefers provenance in answers (source links). So we should include a must-have: each generated answer must include 1-3 source pointers and a provenance score.

kevin - SE: Implementation note: we can return a list like: [{"doc_id":"...","score":0.92,"cursor":...}] and attach to response. For rerank metric we can use weighted score = 0.6*semantic_sim + 0.4*bm25_norm. We'll test both weights in eval.

sam - Solutions Eng: Also need to pick context strategy: either consolidate top-5 doc chunks into a single prompt (if model has 32k) or do iterative tool calls (if 8k). For POC timeline (4 weeks) I'd propose week 1: data ingest + embeddings; week 2: reranker + basic UI; week 3: LLM answer synth + provenance; week 4: tuning + handoff + security review.

nisha - Security: On the questionnaire: they asked about data retention, encryption at rest/in transit, key custody, penetration testing cadence, and access control. We'll need to provide: SOC2 cert + architecture diagram, KMS integration doc, and confirmation that logs can be routed to their SIEM. Dedicated or Private satisfies most of this.

maria - AE: Pricing question they raised — cost per 1M tokens and embedding units for POC estimate. Jordan: can you give a ballpark?

jordan - Customer Success: Ballpark for POC: if we run Track A on hosted with embed-medium + rerank-small and 50k queries over 4 weeks, expect ~$900-1200. Track B (LLM synth heavy, 32k model) could be $2k-3k depending on tokens. If they commit to Dedicated we can provide committed discount to meet their $1.5k target.

kevin - SE: Technical blockers to call out now: 1) documents are scanned PDFs — need OCR & chunking; 2) PII redaction policy — are we allowed to store raw text? 3) Tool-call surface: their facts API requires OIDC; we need token exchange in the tool shim.

maria - AE: I'll confirm the PII policy. On OCR: propose we run an initial offline OCR + chunk on their side or we can spin a worker in Private.

sam - Solutions Eng: For evaluation harness, propose these artifacts: - eval_set.csv (200 queries, intents) - gold annotations w/ doc ids + expected answer snippets - prompt set for generation checks - scorecard template (NDCG, recall@K, exact/partial match). Example prompt we can run at scale:```
User: "What are contraindications for Drug X in cardiac patients?"
System: "Use top-5 docs, cite sources inline as [doc#] and include a confidence 0-1."
```
We'll automate scoring by matching cited spans against gold spans with fuzzy overlap threshold 0.7.

maria - AE: Great. Kevin — do we have a recommended default model pair for the POC we can put in the scoping doc? (one for embeddings + one for synth)

kevin - SE: Default suggestion: embeddings: redwood-embed-medium-v1; rerank cross-encoder: redwood-rerank-small-v1; synth: redwood-32k-instruct-v1 (for provenance + long context). If latency is a hard stop, fallback synth: redwood-8k-instruct-quant-v1 with iterative retrieval. We'll include both in the doc and note tradeoffs.

nisha - Security: I'll prepare a short FAQ for the questionnaire on what Dedicated/Private covers and what hosted cannot. Also will add required network controls and KMS flow diagram.

deploy-bot: POC workspace created: workspace-id=ws-acme-001, created by maria at 1792005685

maria - AE: Perfect — I'll draft the scoping doc with the criteria above and ping legal for the MSA template. Action items: Kevin: add model tradeoffs + perf knobs to doc (due EOD). Sam: draft eval harness and week-by-week plan (due tomorrow). Nisha: attach security FAQ + required docs (due Wed). Jordan: prepare budget options and proposal language.

kevin - SE: On it. I'll also include a sample API call we can use in load tests:```
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-32k-instruct-v1",
  "input": "[CONTEXT]\nUser: {{query}}\nInstruction: Answer concisely and include source tags.",
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "tools": ["facts_api"],
  "tool_args": {"facts_api": {"oidc_token": "<jwt>"}}
}
```

maria - AE: Thanks team — I'll share the scoping doc link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:

maria - AE (edited): scoping doc: https://redwood.internal/poc/acme-1792 (draft)"
